name: qaia
description: Agentic QA platform: from user story to prioritized Gherkin test books and native Playwright tests, running entirely in your Claude session.

plugins.name: qaia-core
plugins.description: QAIA core: US ingestion, need understanding, team knowledge base, ISTQB test design, prioritized atomic Gherkin test books with stable IDs and coverage matrix.

plugins.name: qaia-playwright
plugins.description: QAIA automation: Gherkin test book to native Playwright (POM as fixtures) with traceability, plus accessibility, performance and security-surface checks. Web-first.

plugins.name: qaia-score
plugins.description: QAIA scoring: read-only quality scoring (ISTQB 10-dimension rubric, /20) and a PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL/WAIVED release-readiness gate over the standardized run manifest. Scores only - never edits test content.

plugins.name: qaia-testdata
plugins.description: QAIA test data: generates rich, business-coherent synthetic datasets (never real data or PII) from a QAIA user story or test book, covering boundary/edge cases and injectable as Playwright fixtures. Separate from qaia-core, which only ever generates inline examples.
